methods.description: For each of the 15 complete components, compare its full geometry with every feature in the two complete simplified administrative products; retain pairwise intersects/covers and literal-coordinate area/length diagnostics. No clipping, repair, projection, buffer, snapping, or persisted intersection geometry.
methods.units: Literal GeoJSON longitude/latitude coordinate units; area and length are coordinate-unit diagnostics.

conclusions.text: Both full runs covered all 15 complete components against all 99 features in the two complete simplified products (1,485 pairs per run; 27 intersecting pairs), and the retained positive and negative controls passed. These are source-product diagnostics, not physical land/water or rightful-boundary findings.
Candidate cause, effective dates, source lineage, candidate-scale registration/accuracy, physical land/water status, applicable rights compatibility, and ownership remain unresolved or unapproved.
